description_en: Modifies the cleanup configuration for offline hosts. Only non-Alibaba Cloud hosts are supported
description_zh: 修改离线主机清理配置，仅支持云外主机
kebab_example: aliyun sas modify-asset-clean-config --asset-clean-configs Status=1 CleanDays=7 Type=1 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyAssetCleanConfig

parameters.description_en: The list of asset cleanup configurations.
parameters.description_zh: 资产清理配置的列表信息。

element_fields.description_en:
